caseName: Jamieson v. Chicago Title & Trust Co.
caseNameFull: JAMIESON v. CHICAGO TITLE & TRUST CO.
attorneys: Charles W. Jamieson, appellant, pro se., Daniel S. Wentworth for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
